heading: You're already paying for sport, entertainment, facilities and services. Customers can't act on what they don't know about.
subhead: You've already paid for live sport, played through the week and not just weekends. You've booked artists to perform and have a stage show running for a month. There's also the quiz on the quieter nights.

cards.title: The show's on. The game's on. There's an open-mic.
cards.text: Dinner & a show - that's where your marketing spend is going. There is also the game and a comedy night to promote. Give them equal billing with automated footfall marketing.

cards.title: One speaker system, four kick-offs.
cards.text: Multiple games, and feature game gets the sound, but more people are here for another game so you put music on instead and lose half the crowd.

cards.title: Nobody knew it was on.
cards.text: Trivia, music and comedy live and die on a poster. What if there was a way to to give them equal billing and increase your audience.
